subject: Coord: SOC 2 + Pen Test + DPA walkthrough — availability next week
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finpath.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Petrov <anya@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request to schedule SOC 2 / pen-test / DPA walkthrough

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last month — the team at FinPath is ready to move to a compliance intake. We need a combined walkthrough that covers:
- SOC 2 scope and controls mapping (we'll focus on Type II readiness)
- pen-test logistics and proposed vendor scope (high level)
- DPA specifics (data flows, retention, subprocessor list)

Would a single 90-minute session work, or would you prefer splitting into two shorter calls? Our core attendees: security lead (me), legal (Anya), and the platform engineer. Ideally next week (Jun 28–30) in the morning PT.

Suggested slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 29 — 09:00–10:30
- Wed Jun 30 — 10:00–11:30
- Thu Jul 1 — 08:30–10:00

If those don't work, we'll open up for evening times. Also happy to share our vendor's pen-test checklist beforehand.

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
Security Lead, FinPath Financial
sam.taylor@finpath.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: pen-test-scope-request.pdf (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finpath.com>
Cc: Anya Petrov <anya@finpath.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule SOC 2 / pen-test / DPA walkthrough

Sam — thanks for the clear outline. A single 90-minute session is fine; we typically split the agenda into: 30m SOC 2 controls mapping, 30m pen-test scope & vendor Qs, 30m DPA/data flow review.

I can staff the call and will have Ben join for the pen-test portion and Olga to run the DPA/data-flow discussion. Proposed slots (PT) that work for our team: 

- Tue Jun 29 — 09:00–10:30  (OK)
- Wed Jun 30 — 10:00–11:30  (conflict for Ben)
- Thu Jul 1 — 08:30–10:00  (OK)

If Tue 9am works, we'll send a calendar invite and a short prep pack (SOC2_intake_checklist.pdf, DPA_summary_v1.docx, pen-test-scope.xlsx). If you'd rather do evening for broader attendance, tell us which timezone works and we'll adapt.

Two quick asks on our side:
1) Can you confirm whether the pen-test vendor will require an on-prem environment or is this purely black-box external?
2) Any particular controls you want prioritized during the SOC 2 mapping?

I'll hold the Tue slot provisionally until I hear back.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2_intake_checklist.pdf (stub), DPA_summary_v1.docx (stub), pen-test-scope.xlsx (stub)

Ben / Olga — forwarding Sam's request. I'm provisionally holding Tue Jun 29 09:00–10:30 PT for FinPath. Ben, can you own the pen-test section (30m) and be ready to call out recommended timing for a vendor test? Olga, can you lead the DPA/data-flow discussion and have the subprocessor list handy?

If either slot doesn't work, call it out now and we'll propose Thu Jul 1 08:30–10:00 PT instead.

Ben Carter

Vivek — Tue Jun 29 09:00–10:30 PT works for us. Please send the invite and the prep pack when you can.

A couple of notes before the call:
- Our vendor will run an external black-box test only; no on-prem access required.
- Priority controls: access management, key rotation, and data deletion/retention rules.

We'd appreciate a short pre-read; if you can include the SOC2 checklist and a one-page outline of the pen-test scope, that will help our legal & engineering teams.

Thanks — look forward to the call.
Sam
